Origin and meaning

Margaret is a Greek name meaning “pearl”.

About the name Margaret

The name of Saint Margaret and of the British prime minister Margaret Thatcher.

As a gift or a tattoo

The name Margaret suits a framed gift, and the clean high-resolution file also works as a tattoo design.
